description: This Scala source file defines the DefaultCollationTypeCoercion object used in Spark SQL's analysis resolver to handle collation and string type coercion during query analysis.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the default collation to the given expression based on the specified collation string.

methods.name: hasDefaultStringType
methods.description: Checks if the DataType contains the default StringType, considering nested types.

methods.name: replaceDefaultStringType
methods.description: Replaces instances of the default StringType within a DataType with a new StringType with specified collation.

methods.name: isDefaultStringType
methods.description: Determines if a DataType is the default StringType, considering explicit collation.

methods.name: shouldApplyCollationToCast
methods.description: Checks if a Cast expression should have collation applied based on user-specified cast and dataType.
